scope: Static local-source audit and live documentation/package inspection. No platform features are implemented or GPU-validated by this inventory.
notes: Parameter counts are documentation table rows, not a support percentage. Rows include platform-managed selectors and task-specific arguments.
The 113 default.yaml keys are shared across modes; do not sum per-mode counts to infer unique parameters.
This inventory is not an executable JSON Schema. Runtime compatibility depends on task, model head, format, hardware, dependency environment and API signatures.
Documented descriptions are omitted; names, types, defaults and matrices record configuration facts.
Current evaluation jobs exist, but use platform metrics; no_dedicated_ultralytics_job means no standalone Ultralytics val/export/benchmark job.
stream and persist are API arguments. save_dir and augmentations are allowed custom keys. They must be considered in addition to default.yaml.
Tracking and tuning controls need their own schemas; Solutions and visualization APIs are extensions outside the core train-to-deploy scope.

deprecated_aliases.int8: quantize=8 if true; takes precedence over half when quantize is absent
